description: Seamstress, West Market ward. Mid-thirties, thin through the shoulders. Flattened fingerpads, callus at the base of the middle finger.
knows: that Xu Ping took an unusual interest in her sleeve and did not say why
that she has an ordinary cough, which she has
that she is to come back in ten days
last_seen: his stall, the morning he cut the aconite
name: Guo Lan
not_knows: that he can name a decoction by smell
that anything about the cloth is considered wrong
that he added good cinnamon she could not have paid for
observed_not_explained: Her sleeves carry liquorice, cinnamon bark of good grade, and musk. And a fourth thing he could not name.
owes_owed: paid in full for the cough remedy — apricot kernel, liquorice
toward_player: Wary-polite. Will not name who gave her the private sewing work. Stated fear: her shop master, Dou, learning she takes side work, and the work stopping.
voice: Answers the exact question and nothing adjacent. Apologises when she is not sorry. Goes quiet rather than refuse outright.
